_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2008 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2008 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.14x; -9% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.17; conservative 2yr +73%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY99-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.5%/yr (Q1 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.9%/yr (FY99-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2008-10-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.14x (-17.2% downside to Bear $56 / +126.0% upside to Bull $108) | Adj composite 3.17 vs market 1.00: gap +2.17 [UNDERVALUED] | -9% above the EPP floor $52 (14x FY09E $3.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: +72.9% total (+36.4%/yr) | At 12.8x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits at or below the BASE case; futures orders +10.0% in Q1 FY09, forward revenues +10% (Q1 FY09 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
